mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS below 0.5%) compresses discount rates for equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days. This mechanism operates continuously without regime thresholds.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in 60% or more of periods where FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly CPIAUCSL reading above 3.0% signals persistent inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy and depress equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in 60% or more of periods where CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.0%, or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous expansion in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) above their 12-month moving averages indicates robust consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through stronger corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in 60% or more of periods where both HOUST and RSAFS exceed their 12-month moving averages, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of high unemployment (UNRATE above 5.5%), the S&P 500 exhibits negative forward returns due to reduced consumer spending and corporate profit pressures, with the effect being most pronounced in the short term.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in 60% or more of periods where UNRATE exceeds 5.5%, or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly INDPRO reading below 95.0 indicates a contraction in industrial production, signaling potential economic slowdown and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in 60% or more of periods where INDPRO is below 95.0, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A joint condition of elevated federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS above 0.05%) and high inflation (CPIAUCSL above 268.5) indicates aggressive monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in 60% or more of periods where both FEDFUNDS > 0.05 and CPIAUCSL > 268.5, or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a manufacturing slowdown regime (INDPRO below 95.0), the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns due to declining corporate revenues and profit margins, with the effect being most acute over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in 60% or more of periods where INDPRO is below 95.0, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly GDP growth rate above 2.0% (computed as the year-over-year change in GDPC1) signals a strengthening economy, boosting corporate earnings and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in 60% or more of periods where GDPC1 growth exceeds 2.0%, or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
